links.comparator_used: End-to-end baseline (single model performing the whole verification) versus the decision-basis contract with deterministic rule checks plus LLM documentation assessment
links.outcome: Outcome agreement on 36 curated billing cases across four open-weight models
links.effect: Outcome agreement varied across models and showed no consistent advantage over the baseline; no numbers given in the abstract
links.tradeoff: The evidence gate converted some correct raw judgments into incomplete decision-basis entries
links.quote: Outcome agreement varied across models and showed no consistent advantage over the baseline.

links.comparator_used: Ablation of the contract without explicit documentation requirements
links.outcome: Identification of missing required information in documentation
links.effect: Improved for all four models; no numbers given in the abstract
links.quote: Explicit documentation requirements improved identification of missing information for all four models.

links.comparator_used: Raw model judgments without the verbatim evidence gate
links.outcome: Validity of evidence behind correct raw judgments and conversion to incomplete decision-basis entries
links.effect: Some correct raw judgments lacked valid evidence and were converted to incomplete entries; no counts given in the abstract
links.tradeoff: Correct judgments without valid verbatim evidence were downgraded to incomplete entries, which reduces apparent agreement
links.quote: The evidence gate also exposed cases in which correct raw judgments lacked valid evidence and were converted to incomplete decision-basis entries.
